name: signal_format_markdown_to_signal
notes: Markdown→Signal converter (signal_format.c gateway_signal_markdown_to_signal vs LIVE gateway/platforms/signal_format.py:markdown_to_signal). KNOWN DIVERGENCES (documented; inputs restricted to the agreed region): (1) C compiles ALL six inline patterns with PCRE2_DOTALL, Python only the ** pattern — multi-line inline content diverges; (2) C bullet rewrite requires exactly one space after the marker while Python \s+ eats any run — multi-space bullets diverge; (3) prior-style shift adjustment: Python _adjust shifts partially (min of removal length and overlap), C subtracts the full removal length when it starts before the span — markers straddling code/heading spans diverge; (4) zero-length styles are dropped by C but would be emitted by Python. The twin mirrors the port's scan structure with DOTALL regexes and asserts its final (text, styles) equals the LIVE function's output on every input.
